graph_feature_definitions.reciprocal_counterparties: partners with transactions in both directions
graph_feature_definitions.two_hop_*_unique: distinct accounts reachable in two directed hops, excluding self
graph_feature_definitions.directed_3cycle_count: distinct directed v→u→w→v cycles touching the account
graph_feature_definitions.max_*_counterparties_7d: maximum distinct partners in any 7-day event-anchored window

motif_feature_definitions.fan_in_then_out_14d: maximum distinct senders within 14 days before an outgoing transfer
motif_feature_definitions.in_then_fan_out_14d: maximum distinct receivers within 14 days after an incoming transfer
motif_feature_definitions.directed_cycle_paths_4_10: simple directed cycles of length 4–10 touching the account
motif_feature_definitions.shortest_directed_cycle_4_10: length of shortest such cycle; zero if none

hyperparameter_search: none; identical XGBoost configuration to XGB-Base
threshold_selection: maximize SAR F1 on validation; highest threshold on ties
